title_en: Famous Chinese People (19/20): Liu Xiang, China's "Flying Man" of Track and Field
note_en: 尽管 (jǐnguǎn) means "despite; even though," like 虽然 but more formal. Where English says "despite the ups and downs, many people still…," Chinese can pair 尽管 with 依然 or 还是 ("still") in the main clause instead of 但是: 尽管经历了起伏，刘翔依然被很多人视为中国田径的标志性人物. Note also the formal passive 被…视为… "is regarded by … as …."
